systems_abstraction.rationale: Developed a comprehensive stage theory of cognitive development (sensorimotor, preoperational, concrete operational, formal operational) integrating observations across decades into one coherent developmental framework, documented via the well-established scope of his theoretical corpus.

curiosity.rationale: [ERROR_CORRECTION, roster29 factual gate: the cited sources support 'as a youth,' not a specific age -- 'at age 11' was an unsupported precision, removed] Published an early scientific paper (on an albino sparrow) as a youth and sustained active naturalist/scientific interests before formally shifting to psychology, documented via his own well-established early publication record (Britannica).

detail_orientation.rationale: His clinical-interview method involved detailed, systematic observation and questioning of individual children's reasoning across many documented case studies, evidenced directly in his published research method.

discipline.rationale: Sustained an extraordinarily prolific research and publication output (over 60 books and hundreds of articles) across a six-decade career, documented via his well-established bibliography.

analytical_rigor.rationale: Developed the clinical interview method as a systematic, replicable technique for studying children's reasoning, documented via its lasting methodological influence on developmental psychology research.

independent_thinking.rationale: Developed a stage-based, biologically-grounded theory of cognitive development that departed from both behaviorist and purely nativist accounts dominant in his era, documented via the theory's own distinct framing relative to contemporaneous approaches.

cross_domain_range.rationale: Began his career in biology and malacology (mollusk studies) before shifting to developmental psychology and epistemology, documented via his own well-established academic career trajectory across these genuinely distinct fields.

achievement_drive.rationale: Sustained a prolific research and institution-building career (founding the International Centre for Genetic Epistemology) for six decades, evidencing sustained long-term ambition well beyond his early theoretical contributions.

deep_focus.rationale: The detailed, extended clinical-interview case studies underlying his stage theory evidence sustained concentrated observational work over extended periods.

mastery_orientation.rationale: Continued refining and extending his developmental theory across decades of subsequent research and publication, documented via the internal development visible across his extensive bibliography.

leadership_drive.rationale: Founded and directed the International Centre for Genetic Epistemology in Geneva, documented via the well-established institutional record of that research center under his leadership.

planning_orientation.rationale: The systematic, stage-by-stage structure of his developmental theory evidences real advance conceptual organization built up across an extended research program.

adaptability.rationale: Shifted his primary research focus from biology to psychology to epistemology across his career, suggesting real flexibility in intellectual direction.

collaboration.rationale: Built and directed a research center involving sustained collaboration with numerous other researchers over decades, suggesting real capacity for structured collaborative work.

impact_motivation.rationale: His theory's sustained, explicit application to educational practice and curriculum design suggests real orientation toward broader applied usefulness, not only abstract theory.

experimentation.rationale: His clinical-interview method involved presenting children with novel constructed scenarios and tasks to observe their reasoning directly, a genuinely experimental approach to studying cognition, documented via the well-established methodology of his research.

social_assertiveness.rationale: Sustained an active international academic and institutional public role across his career, including extensive lecturing and institution-building, suggesting real comfort with public professional engagement.

persistence.rationale: Sustained an unusually prolific research output across a six-decade career, evidencing real long-term persistence in his research program.

creative_originality.rationale: Developed a genuinely original stage-based theory of cognitive development that departed from both behaviorist and purely nativist accounts dominant in his era, documented via the theory's own lasting, distinct influence.

risk_tolerance.rationale: Shifting his primary career focus from established biology credentials to the then-nascent field of developmental psychology carried some real professional risk.

resourcefulness.rationale: Developed the clinical-interview method specifically to work around the practical limitation that young children cannot reliably self-report abstract reasoning, a real methodological workaround.
